fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the leaked value.
Use a positional parameter, e.g. db.query("... LIKE $1", ['%' + q + '%']).
Apply path.basename to req.params.name (or resolve and verify the prefix is REPORT_DIR) before sendFile.
Hash passwords with a slow salted algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts/schemes and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Add requireAdmin or verify ticket ownership (e.g. AND owner_id = $2) before deleting.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate format against an allow-list such as ['csv','json'].
